column1: Light falls on a surface and almost all light bounces back (on polished plane surfaces)
Plane surfaces have less friction, thus they have less roughness. Thus most of light bounces back in same direction (does not scatter around). This is called reflection.
Due to reflection we see object at place where it is not present. As light entering our eye is coming from that direction.

column2: $\angle$ of incidence (from Normal) = $\angle$ of reflection (from normal)
Incident ray, the normal and reflected ray, all lie inn same plane.
